Amazing Cocktails with a Stunning View!
Oct 2024 • Business
I had a great time at the upper heaven sky bar in Hanoi. The cocktails were fantastic—well-crafted with great flavors. The ambiance is perfect, and the view is absolutely breathtaking, especially in the evening. The service was also top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who made the experience even better. I would highly recommend this spot for anyone looking to enjoy good drinks and a great atmosphere!

Sep 2024 • Friends

Overall, Best4U is a must-visit for both food lovers and those seeking outstanding service.

Great food and service!
Sep 2024 • Family
Exceptional food and service! 

We had a fantastic dining experience at Best 4U Restaurant at the Souriant Premium Hotel. The atmosphere is absolutely beautiful, creating the perfect setting for a great meal. The food was delicious! -The spring rolls, grilled fish, and the rice noodles with Australian beef were all incredibly fresh and flavorful. The service was outstanding with Suzy and Kim providing such warm and attentive hospitality. It was a wonderful experience and I’d highly recommend it to anyone in the area!
